problem: Obsidian lacks native support for TIPA (TeX IPA) notation, which is used for processing International Phonetic Alphabet symbols in LaTeX.
summary: Implements TIPA (TeX IPA) notation in Obsidian, converting TIPA commands to Unicode phonetic symbols for use in LaTeX contexts.
